note: STT raised both guides, beat EPS and still fell 6% on a 1% revenue miss while BNY consensus sits at the TOP of its own guide-implied H2 run rate (item 2); the 3.5% sympathy fall today and a possible NII raise (item 1) offset most of it, so the net lean is small.

Century auction/merger costs are excluded from the Q3 expense guide and a 2-3 analyst consensus has not moved since the deal (item 0), so a GAAP headline miss is likely — but the bar is disputed ($1.00-$1.08) so every size is capped, and holders looked through the same one-off in Q2.

STLD's 09-17 release — long-products metal margin expanding, record shipments, fabrication backlog ~50% above prior year running through Q1 2027 — is a direct read on the FQ1 guide CMC gives on 10-15, and the tape sold it as a steel negative (item 0); the offset is that peers guided BELOW consensus while CMC's own consensus still sits at its guided top (item 2).

Held-for-sale/discontinued-ops presentation against a still-consolidated $109-114m consensus, plus the annual goodwill test on $204.6m of goodwill behind a $38m equity stub (item 3) and a 0.32x Allerium book-to-bill with no visible catch-up (item 0); the number is large because this name's own prints move 15-43% with 6 of 7 negative, not because the lean is strong.

Brand Partners held near 5,200 against 5,800 a year ago implies revenue down ~10% (item 0), but there is no consensus to miss, the decline is NARROWING from -33%, and the cost base and interest line are materially lower (item 1) — close to a non-result on a $26k-a-day stock.

FBK's 12bp NIM squeeze the night before points at a revenue bar still sitting at the top of EQBK's own H2 guide (items 0, 1) — but this name's reaction function already looked through exactly that setup in Q2 (revenue miss, core beat, +0.47%), and an 18% short build with 5.5 days to cover cuts the other way.

TrendForce on 09-30 has DRAM contract prices up another 10-15% and NAND 15-20% in 4Q26 while Q3 consensus EBITA has not moved since 27 July — the component-cost line is exactly what took the stock down 12.6% last quarter (item 2); a 21% six-week ADR short build at 10.2 days to cover and call-heavy OI (item 4) damp it.

Two sourced facts pull opposite ways and nearly cancel: the FY guide assumed two cuts that never came and a hike instead, on a +1.9%-per-100bp asset-sensitive book that analysts have not credited (item 1), against the CEO's own 09-15 statement that the warehouse softened and utilisation is drifting down plus FBK's deposit-cost squeeze (items 0, 2).

A ~5% short at 6 days to cover built into a 5.2% drawdown with no company cause found, against targets near $33 and a bar that sits at the core run-rate (items 3, 4); FBK's NIM read on the defining line (item 0) is the offset, so the net is close to zero.

Randstad and Adecco both described improving volumes AFTER MAN set its Q3 guide (items 3, 4) and MAN's own Q4 Employment Outlook Survey rose 2 points QoQ into the first Q4 guide (item 6), while revenue consensus sits only ~0.6% above the guide midpoint — the BLS temp-help decline (item 0) is real but lands on the ~15% of revenue that is the US.

Management guided 'more margin expansion in the fourth quarter than in the third' while consensus still embeds ~40bp of R&IS margin expansion in Q3 — the exact line whose flat print drove -8.52% last October (item 5) — reinforced by a +0.5% Guy Carpenter consensus against a rate-on-line index accelerating to -16% (item 1).

The company's own guide arithmetic leaves H2 at $1.545-1.585 against a Q2 run rate of $1.60 with two raises already banked (item 0), and Cushman's 10-09 Q3 absorption of 76.6 msf — the strongest since Q1 2023 and above Prologis's own 220 msf forecast pace — landed after the company last spoke (item 1); 7 of 7 prior prints up. The August equity issue and a 5.2% ten-year are the live offsets.

The September hike arrived ahead of Schwab's own one-hike-in-December scenario (item 0) and peer September cash data — MS sweep deposits up, IBKR credit balances flat-to-up — refutes the cash-sorting fear that drove the 9% drawdown (items 1, 5); sized down hard because this name's prints have never paid on the day (median reaction 0.78%, max 2.22%).

Q3 revenue is already public at 3.3% above the guide midpoint while the profit consensus implies a ~50% net margin against Q2's 55.6%, so the profit bar is stale by 0-9% (item 0), and Foxconn's +38% September plus 3nm starts ahead of plan support a Q4 guide at or above +10-15% (item 1); heavily damped by the capex line that sold the last print and by ASML beating and falling the same session (items 3, 6).

The quarter itself was pre-announced on 09-16 with consensus at the top of the guide, so the only live line is capital: the CFO blamed the buyback pause partly on AFS marks and the ten-year then rose another 28bp into quarter-end on $89.1B of AFS and -$7.1B AOCI (item 0), on a name that has fallen on 6 of 7 prints through 8 straight beats.

The ADR rallied 7.2% in five sessions on peer relief into a company that has guided below the street on three of its last four prints and faces the Meta and Estee Lauder run-off in the Q3 guide (items 2, 3); a 102.75M-share ADR short at 14 days to cover and a guide expectation already at -2% to 0% keep the lean modest.
